extracted text: The alloys were homogenized at 465°C for 24h, followed by air cooling to room temperature. Then hot extrusion at 410-430°C with an extrusion ratio of 12.2:1. The extruded plates were held at 450°C and 470°C separately for 1h, then kept at 480°C for 2h for stepped solution treatment, and then quenched in ambient temperature water. The plates were aged at 130°C for 24h for T6-tempered.
